newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares gain, trend seen. [CORRECTED 17:08 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares gain, trend seen. [CORRECTED 17:08 GMT]

text.p: 1430 GMT - Austrian shares recovered from earlier lows to close higher, and traders said the market was likely to show additional gains over the next few days if volumes picked up.
"If we see some good volumes tomorrow and Wall Street doesn't fall, then it could go strongly higher," said a trader.
* ATX index up 13.04 points or 1.07 percent at 1,237.01
* 13 ATX shares up (corrects from 15), six down, two unchanged.
* Top gainer Oesterreichische Brau-Beteiligungs AG (corrects from BBAG), up five percent at 766.50 ATS
* March ATX future up ten points at 1,236.5
